explication: This repository combines a Chinese-language one-person-business methodology book with a collection of agent skills. A user can consult the skills or follow the book’s documented topics: defining an enterprise, planning it, building a business, and establishing infrastructure. The README also describes a separate business-simulation sandbox. The skill directories are visible in the tree, but their instructions were not sampled, so relationships among skills—and any orchestration behavior—are not established here.
